observations: Photo 0: the back of a black DSLR camera body held in a hand, low resolution.
'Canon' is printed under the rear screen (photo 0).

Visible controls: mode dial with lock and ON/OFF switch at top left, a column of buttons left of the screen (MENU, INFO and others), AF-ON button, a live view and movie switch with START/STOP button, a multi-controller and a rear quick control dial on the right.
This control layout is consistent with a Canon EOS 7D series body, but no model name or number is readable in the photo.
Rear screen is off; camera is not shown powered on.
No lens, front of the body, top LCD, battery, charger or serial label is shown.
Eyecup is fitted; no cracks visible on the screen at this resolution, but the photo is too small to judge wear.

read_from: photo 0 'Canon' printed under rear screen; model not readable

claims.evidence: No model name visible in photo 0 to tie the spec to; the spec list matches a Canon EOS 7D but the model is not read off the camera.
Depends on the model, which is not readable in photo 0; not demonstrated.

claims.claim: 1080p HD video recording with manual control
claims.evidence: A movie START/STOP button is visible in photo 0, but the model and the function are not shown.

risks.risk: Exact model unknown: 7D and 7D Mark II bodies look alike from the back and differ a lot in value, and other Canon bodies share this layout.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the front of the body showing the model badge, plus the serial label underneath.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; model must be read first

risks.risk: Camera may not power on, or shutter, autofocus, screen or card slot may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, taking a shot with a lens attached, and showing it on the rear screen.

risks.risk: High shutter count from heavy use.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count read from a photo taken today.

risks.risk: No lens, battery or charger included; the listing may be body only.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: as body only without battery or charger

risks.risk: Scratched sensor, damaged mount or worn grip not visible from the back.
risks.proof: Photo of the front with the lens off showing the mount and mirror, lit by a torch.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the front of the body showing the model badge
Close-up of the serial label under the body
Video of the camera powering on, taking a shot and playing it back
Shutter count from a photo taken today
Photo of all included items: lens if any, battery, charger
Handwritten note with today's date in shot with the camera
response.reason: The brand Canon is readable in photo 0 but the model is not, and models with this same back layout differ widely in value. A front photo showing the model badge is needed before even a worst case price is possible.
